gates.requiredScope: Exact intended candidate has clean whitespace, complete path inventory, no protected/generated output, no placeholders, and no Feature-036 path.
gates.rationale: Every MergeAndSync candidate requires exact staged-scope proof.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Never while this feature changes tracked files.

gates.requiredScope: Controlled-root, path, link, preview, search, mutation, cancellation, conflict and recovery tests pass in Release.
gates.rationale: Safe real filesystem behavior is the primary Feature-035 contract.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Never while file-manager behavior remains in scope.

gates.requiredScope: The complete solution Release test suite passes.
gates.rationale: A new executable, project integration and shared proof can affect the full repository.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Never while projects or shared executable proof change.

gates.requiredScope: Canonical Coverlet collection keeps all five required framework assemblies at or above 70 percent line coverage.
gates.rationale: Repository merge policy requires the five-assembly coverage gate.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Only if the Constitution and repository gate are formally changed.

gates.requiredScope: DocFX builds with zero warnings/errors and Playwright/Axe documentation smoke passes.
gates.rationale: A learner-facing guide and documentation navigation change.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Only if no learner-facing or DocFX surface changes.

gates.requiredScope: Ubuntu executes the controlled filesystem and application acceptance body.
gates.rationale: Path, link and attribute behavior must remain honest on Linux.

gates.requiredScope: macOS executes the controlled filesystem and application acceptance body.
gates.rationale: macOS is a primary development and runtime platform.

gates.requiredScope: Windows executes controlled filesystem acceptance and PowerShell state parity.
gates.rationale: Casing, read-only attributes and validator parity require Windows proof.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Never while filesystem behavior or autonomous state is delivered.

gates.requiredScope: Repository dependency, secret and supply-chain checks pass on the reviewed head.
gates.rationale: NIST SSDF and MergeAndSync governance remain applicable.

gates.requiredScope: All five maintained guidance surfaces describe the same active Feature-035 context.
gates.rationale: Active feature and later-intake markers change.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Only if no shared guidance or active-feature marker changes.

gates.requiredScope: No new or changed repository script requires Bash/PowerShell parity.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any added or changed .sh or .ps1 file.
